meta.title: Reopen line items on a staggered event
gaps: Open the specific staggered event whose line 1 has expired when no event title or ID is provided
Select Reopen Line Items and reopen line 1
Verify that line 1 is open for bids until the new time
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the specific staggered event whose line 1 has expired when no event title or ID is provided; Select Reopen Line Items and reopen line 1; Verify that line 1 is open for bids until the new time

steps.note: Open an existing event that the runner can use for the buyer-side event inspection.
Open the event Settings menu where Reopen Line Items should be offered.
Assert that the Reopen Line Items action is present and enabled.
